paper_title: Fast and Reliable Metamodeling of Complex Reaction Spaces Using Universal Kriging

quantitative_outcomes.notes: This paper describes a computational method (Universal Kriging) for modeling the reaction space of inorganic nanoparticle (CdSe and CdSeTe quantum dots) synthesis in a microfluidic reactor. It does not investigate or pertain to organic cross-coupling reactions. The model predicts product properties (fluorescence characteristics) as a function of precursor ratios and residence time.
